title: rabdosia calycina
intro: Rabdosia calycina, commonly known as Chinese ehrharta, is a plant species in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rabdosia calycina include reducing inflammation, soothing coughs, and regulating digestion, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids. The bioactive constituents of Rabdosia calycina contribute to its therapeutic potential, and further research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
